name: transcriptlab-chatgpt
description: Turn YouTube videos and audio or video files into searchable, exportable transcripts inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: TranscriptLab turns YouTube videos and audio or video files into clean, searchable text inside ChatGPT. Paste a YouTube link to pull the video's existing caption track in the language you choose, or attach an audio or video file and transcribe it with speech-to-text. Every transcript you deliver lands in your library, where you can search or quote it, open it again later, download it as TXT, SRT, VTT, Markdown, or JSON, and ask ChatGPT to summarize it, outline chapters, or pull key quotes.
defaultPrompt: Get the transcript for a YouTube video.
Transcribe an audio or video file I attach.
Find a transcript I saved earlier.
